```{r the reason for climate class reclassification}
#
sites_long <- read.csv(file.path('data2026', 'long_term_ec_sites.csv'))
#
source(file.path("scripts2026", "00_functions.R"))
df_file_structure <- get_rawflux_file_structure(dir_rawdata)
#
for (i in 1:nrow(sites_long)) {
  
  i = 143   
  # i =162: US-Me2: reported climate Csb (warm-summer Medit climate), however, it does not satisfy criteria of the climate Csb (coldest month temperature > 0; precipitation of wettest month is 3 times of driest month) 
  # Instead, it should belong to Dfb (coldest month averaging below 0 °C (32 °F) (or −3 °C (26.6 °F)), all months with average temperatures below 22 °C (71.6 °F), and at least four months averaging above 10 °C (50 °F).)
  
  # i = 143: US-Vcp: reported climate Dfb (Warm Summer Continental: significant precipitation in all seasons); however, precipitation differs significantly between months. 
  #
  
  
  print(i)
  site_ID <- sites_long$site_ID[i]
  print(site_ID)
  folder <- unlist(df_file_structure$folders[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]])
  DDfile <- df_file_structure$DDfiles[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]]
  YYfile <- df_file_structure$YYfiles[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]]
  a_DD <- read.csv(folder[grepl(pattern=paste0(site_ID, DDfile), folder)])
  a_YY <- read.csv(folder[grepl(pattern=paste0(site_ID, YYfile), folder)])
  #
  a_DD[a_DD==-9999] <- NA
  a_YY[a_YY==-9999] <- NA
  
  a_DD$TIMESTAMP <- ymd(a_DD$TIMESTAMP)
  tmp <- a_DD %>% mutate(MONTH = month(TIMESTAMP)) %>% group_by(MONTH) %>% 
    summarise(tp = sum(P_ERA, na.rm = T) / nrow(a_YY), ta = mean(TA_F_MDS, na.rm = T))
  tmp
  
  
}







```
